_README: Editable inputs for landed_cost.py. null = not set: counted as 0 in the math AND listed in missing_inputs. Set DEAL_HUNTER_COST_CONFIG=/path/to/file.json to run with a different config (isolated test mode) without touching this one. Customer shipping, postage and packaging are independent blocks under resale.

fx._note: Set JPY to USD per 1 yen (for example 0.0065). buffer_pct widens the cost to cover rate drift and your card/PayPal conversion spread.

domestic_us._tax_note: 6% Kentucky sales tax on taxable domestic inventory purchases (set 2026-11-20 by owner). No resale exemption and no active LLC assumed.

discogs._notes: Both fees verified against official pages on 2026-11-20 (see 'verified'). Marketplace fee and processing are SEPARATE charges, each applied once per order. International sales and currency conversion are not modelled.

verified.paypal: PayPal Checkout / Guest Checkout / Venmo 3.49% + fixed fee; US dollar fixed fee 0.49 USD (PayPal US merchant fee page, last updated May 19, 2026: https://www.paypal.com/webapps/mpp/merchant-fees ; fee PDF https://www.paypalobjects.com/marketing/ua/pdf/US/us-merchant-fees-09-feb-2026.pdf). Standard card payments are 2.99% + 0.49 and Pay Later 4.99% + 0.49, so 3.49% + 0.49 is the conservative default. International sales add a surcharge that is NOT modelled (domestic US only).
verified.discogs: 9% marketplace fee on item + shipping, confirmed earlier from the Discogs help center seller-fee articles (see fee_verification.json). Confirm in your seller dashboard.

customer_shipping._note: What the BUYER pays you: $7.99 covers up to 3 records, +$0.50 per additional record.

postage._note: YOUR actual postage (media mail ~2 lb). Per-additional is unset: only flagged when an order has more than 3 records.

packaging._note: Box + packing material per order (bought-box price).

decision_safety._notes: Report-only by default: every deal gets buy_now_blockers / buy_now_gate_pass but decisions change only when enforce_buy_now_gate is true.

inbound_shipping._note: What YOU pay a store to ship an order to you. null = unknown (counted as 0 and flagged missing_inputs). flat_usd = shipping for one order; per_additional_usd = extra per record beyond the first; free_over_usd = order subtotal at/above which shipping is free. One order from one store pays shipping ONCE, so combined orders can cross free_over_usd. Fill these in from each store's shipping policy; nothing here is guessed.
